description: Find who to ask about a saved job application: the hiring manager when JobGPT is confident, otherwise a peer who could refer you. slot ('hiring_manager' or 'referral') says which. alreadyContacted ({date}) is set when JobGPT already emailed this person for this application. If nobody is found the call fails with a not-found message; if the lookup fails, try again in a minute.

limit.description: Maximum number of contacts to return (default: 2, max: 2)

name: get_application_referrers
